posts.title: Top 5 Money-Saving Habits to Remember at the Grocery Store!
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
Thank you so much for tuning into my 3TV/CBS5 money-saving habits to remember at the grocery store segment today (if you missed the segment you can watch it here)! If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list here (unsubscribe anytime). Please tell a friend about my site so we can all “live life better for less” together. You can also find out first about the latest and greatest bargains when you “like” Alicia’s Deals on Facebook and follow Alicia’s Deals on Instagram.
If you implement these five little habits into your life, you'll be amazed at how much you save.
Check the grocery ads every Wednesday (they come out online on Tuesday if you want to plan ahead). I put together my favorite deals at each store each week, head over here to see the deals for this week (2/26-3/4)! Different stores have doorbuster deals on certain items each week; if you use the discounted items a lot, it's worth making a trip.
If you're 55 or better, shop at Albertsons, Bashas', Fry's, and Safeway on the first Wednesday of each month to save an automatic 10% off groceries. That can add up fast!
If you're stressed about the egg shortage, add Trader Joe's to your shopping rotation. They only allow one dozen per family BUT they've been in stock every time I've gone AND they're not insanely expensive.
Think about the seasons when you're planning your meals. When you buy in-season produce, you'll almost always pay less (and it's fresher and more delicious).
Bring your own bags! It's better for the earth and if you don't at Aldi or Sprouts, you'll have to pay for them.
Check out my save big at the grocery store with technology post here!
Happy saving!

posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here
The holidays will be here BEFORE WE KNOW IT! If you want to get some good cheer on the calendar, head over here to pick up discount tickets to see the Trans Siberian Orchestra on Sunday, December 3rd at 3 PM or 7:30. You'll pay $44.99 a ticket instead of $85, a full 47% off!
"Prepare for a musical journey like never before with Trans-Siberian Orchestra - a fusion of rock, classical, and holiday magic
Seating: 200 Level
To make sure group purchases are seated together, you must purchase your group's G-Passes in the same transaction and redeem your vouchers together at the venue.
G-Pass can only be redeemed on mobile app
Click here to view the seating chart
How G-Pass Works: Within an hour of purchase, your G-Pass will be in your account. Pull up the G-Pass on your mobile app. You may redeem your G-Pass via the mobile app and use it to enter the venue directly; you won’t need to redeem at will call. You will not be able to print a paper voucher for this event. Discount reflects the merchant’s current ticket prices - price may differ on day of event.
Trans-Siberian Orchestra - The Ghosts Of Christmas Eve
Trans-Siberian Orchestra (TSO) is a progressive rock band founded as an outlet for the many rock operas late rock industry veteran, producer, composer, and musician Paul O’Neill was writing.
TSO was created to push the boundaries of what was possible for a band to create – both musically and visually. Paul O’Neill dreamed of a different kind of “band” that is not limited by the confines of traditional rock acts and instead established one with multiple singers who could inhabit the various characters he was writing into his rock operas.
Although TSO is best known for their Capra-esque trilogy of holiday records – Christmas Eve & Other Stories, The Christmas Attic, and The Lost Christmas Eve – they have also released several other rock operas. Beethoven’s Last Night (2000) was the first of these non-holiday rock operas and tells a compelling tale of a battle for Beethoven’s soul between good and evil. It features instrumental crossovers between classical composers and contemporary rock, along with original vocal tracks featuring Patti Russo (Meatloaf) as the character Teresa, Beethoven’s love. Later albums take on great themes such as war and redemption, namely Night Castle (2009). Night Castle was TSO’s first Top 5 album debut and included a bonus track featuring Greg Lake (Emerson, Lake & Palmer, King Crimson), who was one of TSO’s greatest influences. Letters From The Labyrinth (2015) was another Top 10 release for TSO. In total, TSO has sold in excess of 12 million albums and DVDs.
Consistently one of the Top 25 touring acts in the country, TSO shows no signs of slowing down. Since its touring debut in 1999, TSO has played over 2,000 Winter Tour shows for more than 18 million fans. So far TSO has also donated over $18 million from these tours to local charities.
At the time of his passing, O’Neill had several TSO projects in various stages of completion at his recording studio in Florida. He also had two finalized rock operas: Romanov: When Kings Must Whisper, about the 1917 Russian Revolution, along with a live concert adaptation of Night Castle. O’Neill also planned to eventually bring the TSO experience to Broadway. Nearly 25 years after the release of their first album, Trans-Siberian Orchestra continues to create and live on."

posts.title: Know Someone Having a Baby? Let Them Know About Three Hot Baby Boxes They Can Get Just For Registering!
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
If you know someone having a baby, huge congratulations to them! This is such an exciting time for families and definitely something to look forward to! There are great baby box bonuses expectant parents can get just for registering (these are full of really great must-haves)!
Head over here to check out the registry at Babylist. You can add items from ALL DIFFERENT STORES (including Etsy) making life easier for you and your gift-givers! What's even better is that you'll get a 15% completion discount AND a free baby box after something for at least $10 is bought off the registry (there is a shipping charge).
If you're a member of Amazon Prime, it's worth heading over here to register. You'll get a FREE welcome box worth up to $35 when you complete at least 60% of your registry checklist and buy something worth $10 from the registry. If you're a Prime member, you'll also get a 15% completion discount.
"Frequently asked questions:
Q: How do I become eligible to get a Welcome Box?
A: Welcome Box is available to select customers with active Prime accounts who create a Baby Registry, complete 60% of their Checklist, and have over $10 of purchases from their registry (from themselves or gifters). The $10 threshold does not include tax or shipping costs. It also does not include purchases of Prime or Gift Cards.
Q: Once I am eligible, how can I get a Welcome Box?
A: Once you are eligible, you will see a “Claim Now” button on both the Benefits and Welcome Box pages of your Baby Registry. Click the ‘Claim Now’ button to add the Welcome Box to your cart. In Checkout, be sure the ‘Use your $35.00 Promotional balance’ check box is selected in order to receive your Welcome Box for free. If this box is not selected at Checkout, you will not receive the Welcome Box for free. Note that this is a limited time offer, good while supplies last. Only eligible customers, logged into their Amazon.com account, will be able to redeem the offer.
Q: I completed the $10 purchase requirement, but the box isn't checked and I can't claim my Welcome Box yet, how come?
A: You have to wait until your $10 of purchases are shipped. Once your orders ship from the Amazon.com facility your requirement will be completed and you will be able to claim your box.
Q: Are there any limitations to the locations the Welcome Box ships to?
A: The Welcome Box can only be shipped within the continental United States. The Welcome Box cannot be shipped to APO addresses or addresses in Alaska and Hawaii.
Q: What products will be included in the Welcome Box?
A: It’s a surprise! The box will include a selection of products for both baby and parents.
Q: Do I need to add an item from each category to complete a registry?
A: You can manually mark any category in the Registry Checklist as complete if you already have or do not need those items. Once you have either added an item or manually marked the item as complete for 60% of the Registry Checklist categories, you will satisfy this requirement to receive a Welcome Box.
Q: Do I need to be the primary owner of the Amazon Prime account to be eligible for a Welcome Box?
A: The Welcome Box will only be available to the Baby Registry owner, that has a Prime membership or is receiving Prime Benefits as part of an Amazon Household. Individuals who have received Prime Shipping benefits but are not part of Amazon Household will not be eligible.
Q: Do I need to be the primary owner of the Baby Registry to be eligible for a Welcome Box?
A: Yes, the Welcome Box will only be available to the primary owner of the Baby Registry.
Q: Will I be eligible for the Welcome Box if I am an Amazon Student Prime Member?
A: Yes."
The easiest baby welcome kit to get is at Target! Head over here to register and you'll be eligible for a FREE welcome kit worth $150 (just stop into guest services to request your kit, I would call ahead to make sure they have some in stock). They also offer a 15% off registry completion discount and other great perks.
On a completely unrelated note, has anyone had flashbacks to pregnancy tests with the new rapid antigen tests and looking for the line? They are so much less exciting.
There is absolutely no reason you can't have three registries!
Enjoy!

posts.title: Military and First Responders Get Into the Phoenix Open FOR FREE...Plus Free Tickets With Purchase at Safeway for All, and More!
posts.excerpt: The Phoenix Open officially starts today! Everyone gets in FREE today and tomorrow (1/28) for Ford Free Days. Keep in mind that kids under 17 get in free with…
posts.text:
The Phoenix Open officially starts today! Everyone gets in FREE today and tomorrow (1/28) for Ford Free Days. Keep in mind that kids under 17 get in free with an adult.
If you know someone who has served in the military or as a first responder (EMT, firefighter, or police officer), let them know that they can head over here to get a FREE voucher for themselves and a guest.
"FREE TOURNAMENT ADMISSION FOR FIRST RESPONDERS AND U.S. MILITARY
The Waste Management Phoenix Open tournament hosts, The Thunderbirds, invite all First Responders, as well as all Active, Reserve, Veterans and Retired U.S. Military personnel, plus one accompanying individual, to be their guests (free of charge) at the 2020 Waste Management Phoenix Open. This marks the 19th year The Thunderbirds have extended this small gesture of thanks to the heroes who’ve given so much for our country.
TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE FREE ADMISSION OFFER:
You must verify your status through Sheer ID.
Eligible personnel must present their official ID or badge along with ticket voucher at the main tournament entrance.
Business cards and pay stubs will not be accepted as forms of ID.
Tickets are limited to two per day, per each official ID.
Standard tournament spectator policies will be in enforced, including no firearms allowed."
"As a further compliment to Military personnel, the Birdies for the Brave Patriots Outpost hospitality tent will be available Wednesday through Sunday of tournament week. Located on the 18th hole near the tee box, all Active, Reserve, Veterans and Retired U.S. Military can invite one guest to enjoy complimentary food and beverages while watching PGA TOUR golf in a relaxed and comfortable setting.
To ensure that all our military heroes can experience the Birdies for the Brave Patriots Outpost, official military ID’s must be presented at the Outpost entrance and the one guest maximum will be strictly enforced."
If you stop by Safeway you can get a free ticket with purchase of $50 of participating alcohol and other products (look for signs).
Head over here for more information about how to get two free general admission passes from Desert Ridge Marketplace or here for information about how to get the freebies from Tempe Marketplace when you spend $300 in one day. I love to buy gift cards at Target or other stores I shop at with this promotion. You could even buy yourself a Visa gift card! It’s definitely a deal, Friday and Saturday Phoenix Open passes are $60 EACH (you’ll save $120)!
NOTE: They are running very low on tickets so I would definitely call ahead before you make a special trip.
I am most excited about the freebies for the brave men and women who have sacrificed serving our country!
Enjoy!

"DreamWorks Animation and Pearl Studio’s co-production Abominable takes audiences on an epic 2,000-mile adventure from the streets of a Chinese city to the breathtaking Himalayan snowscapes. posts.title: Fun Vacation Idea...Washington DC (Where The Best Things are FREE)! Top 5 Tips from Our Trip!
posts.excerpt: For part of our spring break adventure this year we decided to do DC. If this isn't on your list to do with kids, it really is an incredible trip. As a deal…
posts.text:
For part of our spring break adventure this year we decided to do DC. If this isn't on your list to do with kids, it really is an incredible trip. As a deal lover I was very thankful that the best things to do were absolutely free. Start searching for bargains on airline tickets and hotels/VRBO's!
I put together a few tips to make your trip as memorable as possible.
1. Contact your Congresspeople as far in advance as you can. They can request tours for you...even a tour of the White House (not guaranteed and we didn't get one this time...good excuse to go back!). Sam Sabol in David Schweikert's office gave us a fascinating tour of the capitol. All of us learned so much about our government and state representatives. David Schweikert himself met us partway through with his beautiful daughter Olivia and took us down a secret set of stairs to show us the crypt meant for George Washington (it's empty since he's buried at Mount Vernon). Even though we aren't in Raul Grijalva's district, he still signed us up for a great tour/discussion through the Supreme Court. He also gave us passes to see the House and Senate in person. I wrote to Kyrsten Sinema's office and she invited us to a coffee she was hosting while we were in town. It was so much fun to actually meet the people who represent us.
Here's a list of who helped us (it's definitely worth a try to contact all of the AZ congresspeople):
District 6 Representative David Schweikert: Head over here to fill out a DC Tour Request Form.
District 3 Representative Raul Grijalva: Head over here to fill out a DC Tour Request Form.
Senator Krysten Sinema: Head over here to contact her office. They also offer a meeting request option.
2. Visit as many monuments and memorials as you have time for. The Washington Monument elevator is closed for a few more weeks but if you're visiting later than that, head over here for information about how to reserve passes for $1.50.
3. Go to as many Smithsonian Museums (and other museums) as you can! There are 19 museums, galleries, gardens, and zoos to see and each is worth seeing. We loved the American History Museum (where else can you see the original Star Spangled Banner and Dorothy's slippers?!). Head over here to request free timed passes to the new National Museum of African American History and Culture. The United States Holocaust Museum is not a Smithsonian Museum, but still free (and incredibly powerful). Head over here to request online tickets (you'll pay a $1 fee for reserving online).
4. Eat lunch at the Supreme Court or the Longworth Building Cafeteria. The food is pretty good and not crazy expensive. You'll be eating among some powerful people.
5. Go to Arlington Cemetery and pay respects to the brave men and women who gave their lives for our freedom. The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier is something every American should see in their lifetime, the Changing of the Guard happens every hour. The Eternal Flame burns at the grave site of John and Jacqueline Kennedy.
The more we're all interested in our government, hopefully the better it will be.
Enjoy!

We love going to this every year, it really is a magical experience.
“The New York Times called Ballet Arizona’s production of Ib Anderson’s The Nutcracker “one of the three finest” in the country. Lovers of ballet, lovers of the holidays or simply lovers of pure, thrilling spectacle flock each year to this Tchaikovsky classic. Filled with enchanted toys, mischievous mice and sugar plum fairies, the tale of Clara and her magical Nutcracker Prince has enraptured generations of children and adults. Now Ballet Arizona returns with its traditional yet dynamic version of The Nutcracker, which is charged with the stunning choreography of Ib Andersen, the company’s acclaimed artistic director, and accompanied by the Phoenix Symphony. Create a new holiday tradition — or relive memories of holidays past — with Tchaikovsky’s immortal The Nutcracker.:
I’m pretty excited about the new Easy Cancel option on Goldstar too!
“Frequently Asked Questions
What is Easy Cancel?
It’s one of the perks that comes along with buying tickets on Goldstar. It allows you to exchange your current date for another date or pick a new event entirely. These options are available to you as long as the offer (date/time) you purchased is still on sale on our site or app. If you choose to use Easy Cancel, you’ll get Goldstar store credit in the amount of your purchase. Goldstar credit includes the ticket prices as well as any service fees.
How do I use Easy Cancel?
You can start the exchange or credit process by clicking the Use Easy Cancel button on the My Tickets page. From there you just choose the number of tickets you want to cancel and select “confirm.”
How do I know if the offer I purchased is still on sale so I can cancel my tickets?
On your My Tickets page, under the “Need to Change Your Date” section, you’ll see the date and time the offer is set to expire. The offer expiration date/time is set in advance by the ticket supplier and it typically does not change after it’s been set. However, the ticket supplier can close sales early, and occasionally they choose to do so. It’s always best to view the offer expiration date/time at the time you receive your gift or complete your purchase. If you are considering using Easy Cancel, the sooner you can make your decision, the better. If the offer you purchased hasn’t yet expired, you can change dates or get credit for your tickets. If the offer has expired, you will see a message saying that tickets are no longer cancellable.
Will Easy Cancel cost me anything?
No. It is one of the perks of buying on Goldstar, and you get Goldstar credit for both the ticket price and service fees.
What is Goldstar credit? Where does my credited money go?
If you use Easy Cancel, the full value becomes credit on your Goldstar account. This credit never expires and can be used for any purchase on Goldstar. The credit will appear automatically during the checkout process when you make your next purchase. You can see your credit balance on the left side of your Account.
I bought a ticket for a friend who can’t go to the event. Can I get a partial credit?
Yes, with Easy Cancel you can cancel some or all of your tickets for Goldstar credit, as long as the offer (date/time) you purchased is still on sale on our site and app. Just select the number of tickets you would like to return, and you will receive a full Goldstar credit for those tickets and service fees.
Why can’t I use Easy Cancel on every purchase?
You can no longer use Easy Cancel after the offer you purchased has expired because at that point, sales have closed and the will-call list has been sent to the supplier. Once the supplier has received the will-call list, they must be paid for every ticket, so cancellations are not possible. Occasionally, offers may expire earlier than expected due to a supplier request to close sales. Also, there are a very small number of events for which cancellations are never allowed. These special instances are identified before you get to the purchase process so there are no surprises.”
I love this!
Enjoy!

posts.text:
It’s the first Friday of April and that means downtown Phoenix is the place to be tonight!
Everyone will get into the Children’s Museum of Phoenix FREE from 5-9 PM. Since tickets are usually $12 each this alone would save my family $48! Head over here for more information.
From 6 to 10 PM everyone will get in free to the Phoenix Art Museum! General admission tickets for adults are usually $18 each so this is some serious savings (and FUN)! Head over here for more information. I'm excited about the DanceFest going on tonight and the poetry reading! Both special events are FREE!
You’ll definitely want to make a stop at the Heard Museum! From 6-10 PM everyone will get in free. Admission for adults is usually $18! Head over here for more information and check out the special event they have going on tonight:
"Rock Out with the Heard!
6:15 p.m. Special Screening of RUMBLE – The Indians who Rocked the World in Steele Auditorium
8:15 p.m. Special performance by Samantha Crain in the Virginia G. Piper Charitable Trust Grand Gallery
Film and music goers can add another Phoenix venue to their list on First Friday, April 2018 when No Festival Required screens RUMBLE: The Indians Who Rocked the World. RUMBLE tells the story of a profound, essential, and until now, missing chapter in the history of American music: The Indigenous influence. Following the film, singer-songwriter Samantha Crain (Chocktaw) will perform in the Virginia G. Piper Charitable Trust Grand Gallery.
Delicious snacks from the Heard Museum café and cantina are available for purchase throughout the movie. This event is free and open to the public.
About Samantha Crain:
Samantha Crain won Best Folk Album of the Year and Songwriter of the Year at the Native American Music Awards in 2009. Her music has been heard on 90210, HBO’s Hung and many independent documentaries and films."
If our family managed to check out all three museums, we would save $125 on admission alone (and we would have A LOT to talk about)!
Enjoy!

posts.title: Reminder: Celebrate Teacher Appreciation Day With Deals!
posts.excerpt: Teacher Appreciation Day is May 3rd this year (TOMORROW) and I’m trying to put together all of the deals I can find to celebrate the WONDERFUL teachers our…
posts.text:
Teacher Appreciation Day is May 3rd this year (TOMORROW) and I’m trying to put together all of the deals I can find to celebrate the WONDERFUL teachers our kids learn from! Thank you so much for all you do!
Chipotle: “In honor of Teacher Appreciation Day, we’re giving all educators a BOGO. Teachers, faculty and staff: bring in your school ID to any Chipotle in the U.S. on Tuesday, May 3rd, 2016 from 3pm–close to receive a BUY-ONE/GET-ONE BURRITOS, BOWLS, SALADS, or ORDER OF TACOS. “
Organ Stop Pizza: Teachers can “come in to Organ Stop Pizza in Mesa between May 2 and May 6th, 2016 during regular business hours, (5 p.m. – 9 p.m.), and get a gift card for a free pizza*. Any size pizza, no limit on toppings. Value up to $20.
Must be an employed K-12 teacher and show valid school ID. (Working at a school does not qualify).
*Free Pizzas are for dine-in only.
*Free pizza coupon may be redeemed immediately or on a future visit.
*Coupons expire 8/31/16″
World of Beer: “World of Beer (WOB) taverns nationwide are offering teachers a free Angry Orchard cider or Sam Adams beer on Teacher Appreciation Day, May 3. Whether guests are coming for a drink after the bell rings or thinking about pairing their brew during dinner plans, WOB wants to reward America’s educators by inviting them to enjoy a cold one at locations across the country by presenting a valid teacher ID. Guests in Arizona, Texas, North Carolina, Ohio, Virginia and New York can anticipate five dollars off their check in lieu of a free beer.
“At World of Beer, we want to recognize and reward our educators for their work and devotion to shaping minds,” said Paul Avery, president and CEO of World of Beer. “We hope that teachers across the country pencil us into their plans on May 3 and join us in raising a glass to all their hard work.”
Papa Murphy’s: On Monday, May 2, 2016, Papa Murphy’s will kickstart Teacher Appreciation Week with a very special offer. Teachers can take 50% off a pizza with a teacher ID. From open to close on Monday, May 2nd only— get half-off any pizza, any size at regular price—excludes mini-murph, sides and desserts at all participating Valley locations. Hours may vary per store. Go to www.papamurphys.com for a location near you.
McDonalds: “Phoenix and northern Arizona McDonald’s restaurants will thank local teachers with a special Teacher Appreciation Day offer available only through the McDonald’s Mobile App. The Mobile App one-day offer for a “Free Medium McCafé Beverage” will only be valid for 24 hours on Teacher Appreciation Day, May 3!
Phoenix and northern Arizona teachers are encouraged to download the McDonald’s Mobile App and register to receive the free offer at participating McDonald’s restaurants. No purchase is necessary.
“We appreciate the hard work and dedication of our teachers and hope they download our convenient Mobile App to enjoy a free McCafé beverage on Teacher Appreciation Day,” said Michelle Slayton, president of McDonald’s Owner/Operator Association of Phoenix and Northern Arizona. “Whether it’s our freshly made coffee or our cool smoothies, rich shakes or a tasty frappé, we’ve got something guaranteed to make their day.”
Teachers will receive their choice of a McCafé beverage. The McCafé menu includes: Hot and Iced Coffee; Hot Mochas, Lattes, and Premium Hot Chocolate; Iced Mochas and Frappes; Real Fruit Smoothies; and McCafé Shakes.” I’ve heard this free drink will be available on the app for all of us (not just teachers)!
Fluid Martial Arts Academy (Tempe): “Teachers & school staff and their families train free for the entire months of May and June at Fluid Martial Arts. New members only.
We offer: Kenpo Karate, Brazilian Jiu Jitsu(ground fighting), Judo(take downs), Muay Thai kickboxing, wrestling.
Classes offered:
• 3-5 year olds in our Tiny Tigers(we have 8 cute little ones)
• 6-15 Youth program
• Adult classes
• Day and evening classes available
• Open Monday thru Saturday”
If you know of other great Teacher Appreciation Day deals please let me know and I’ll add them to the list!
Thanks Rhonda, Charlotte, Alie, Tim, Tracy, and Andrea!

I talked about this deal in my Your Life A to Z segment this week and they made the deal even better! Now code DEALS will get you 30% off instead of 20% off!
Be Good for Children is a new company founded by an amazing Arizona mom, Karolyn Stayer, who was an executive with Philosophy for many years. She realized there was a huge need for children’s products that are completely safe and good for kids’ skin. It’s scary how many chemicals are in shampoos and body washes we give our children and even babies! Be Good has a line of body wash, shampoo, lotion, and more that you and your children will love and feel good about. My kids have crazy sensitive skin and they use the products and smell amazing (no irritation AT ALL)! Head over here and use code DEALS this week only to get an extra 30% off! You can check out the product in person at Frances Vintage on Camelback and Central (30% discount only applies to online orders).
Here's a little bit of background about the products (from BeGoodforChildren.com):
"With 10+ years experience creatively developing and marketing luxury personal care products for one of the most beloved brands in cosmetics, I was inspired to bring my experience in the industry together with my passion for raising good little people and making a difference.
Be good is a socially conscious, next generation for this generation, personal care company. Be good is full of charm, free of harmful ingredients, and is suitable for children of all ages. It was created by a mother who recognized the need to create clean, safe, virtue-based products that would help teach children the value of good behavior and good grooming.
When it comes to titles, "mother" is the one I am most proud to call mine. As a mom of two young children, I found the options for high-quality, natural products that were safe and smelled delightful were few and far between, especially once my kids moved past the baby stage. I was on a constant search for products that had meaning, would look beautiful in my home (I do really love you elmo, just not in my bathroom), bring a smile to my children’s faces, and be something the whole family could enjoy.
Be good formulas are 90%+ natural, formulated in the USA, and are safe for children of all ages. Our formulas were created to deliver the most natural product possible without sacrificing product performance. Our goal is to create beautiful formulas that are pure and safe, feel amazing on your family’s skin and hair, deliver great results, and provide a delightfully delicate scent that the whole family will adore.
Our formulas are free of: parabens, phthalates, petrochemicals, gluten (with exception of the cleansing conditioner), synthetic dyes, dea, palm oil, added hormone disrupters, petrolatums, dioxanes from sulfates, phosphates, bpa, animal by-products, and we never test on animals.
The packaging was made soft to the touch in a shape easy for parents and children to hold. It was created for mothers who appreciate simplicity, sweetness, and style. Moms who value virtues, character, and good behavior and like the idea of turning everyday moments into teaching moments. Finally, it was created for Moms who believe children’s products need not shout with big, bright, bold color pallets and animated cartoon characters to appeal to children."

This heartwarming story about the importance of ordinary acts of kindness and decency has become a beloved holiday tradition.”

Along the way, they learn to accept one another, warts and all. Set to a clever, jazzy score, A Year With Frog and Toad is pure charm for the family.”

posts.title: Don't Forget to Snag Your Pogo Passes for Family Fun This Summer (And All Year)!
posts.excerpt: Heading on a weekend vacation (yay!) and wanted to put my favorite deal for family fun up top before I go! Have a great weekend and looking forward to checking…
posts.text:
Heading on a weekend vacation (yay!) and wanted to put my favorite deal for family fun up top before I go! Have a great weekend and looking forward to checking back in early next week!
You can head over here to get Pogo Passes for just $39.98 each with code ALICIA (usually $99.95). They are the best value around and are good for a FULL YEAR! You get free admissions into places all over town (so you get to see a lot of what the valley has to offer including Sunsplash, Castles and Coasters, the Phoenix Zoo, Dbacks Games, and LOTS More)! Since I’ve written about them last, they’re now good at select Phoenix Mercury Games and at Pump it Up in Tempe and Peoria! Each pass is worth $1200 (will be worth $1500 when Fat Cats opens this summer) and is a WONDERFUL value. It pays for itself so fast and you’ll have wonderful memories!
Check out what Alicia’s Deals reader Rachel had to say about the passes on the facebook page:
“This was one of the best purchases we’ve made! So much fun stuff to do with family for a great price!! I even bought 2 for my college aged daughter and her boyfriend to have dates–They are struggling students. thank you SO much Alicia for this deal. We have great family memories. We will be re-newing ours for sure!” Thank you Rachel!
Here’s what’s included:
Each pass holder will enjoy one general admission ticket to Sunsplash during the year. Opening Day is May 16th! General admission tickets are usually $29.99. Head over here for hours and days they’ll be open and for more information about the park!
Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves one (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass (worth $29.99). This includes unlimited rides and mini golf.We went and had SUCH a wonderful day! We even got to enjoy the ropes course! The kids have been talking about the place non stop.
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Some experiences require an additional fee. Admission to ZooLights and select special events is not included. An adult general admission is usually $20, so this is a $40 value for adults. There are water areas and playgrounds so you can cool off in the hot summer months!
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season.
Available Hours
Pass holders can choose two (2) of the available Games for the 2015 MLB Regular Season.
Wed, 6/17 vs. LAA 6:40 PM
Fri, 7/24 vs. MIL 6:40 PM
Tue, 8/11 vs. PHI 6:40 PM
Fri, 10/2 vs. HOU 6:40 PM
Registration button appears on this page (2) weeks prior to game day. Must register your Pogo Pass to reserve tickets at will call. Login to your account for a list of your available passes. June 17th is my son's birthday and he's definitely excited to go to the game!
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to Pump It Up in Tempe or Peoria two (2) times. To gain admission, simply present your Pogo Pass at the front desk.
Available during regular business hours for open jump Monday-Friday. Mon-Fri: 10am-12pm, 12pm-2pm, 2pm-4pm Mon-Thurs: 4pm-7pm Fri: 4pm-6pm
Tempe: Ages 2yrs (34″) and up.
Peoria: Ages 2yrs (34″) to 10yrs old.
Pass holders can attend three (3) Games for the WNBA Regular Season. Available games are as follows.
Fri, June 19 vs. Connecticut Sun 7:00 PM
Sat, July 18 vs. New York Liberty 7:00 PM
Fri, August 21 vs. Los Angeles Sparks 7:00 PM
Registration opens two (2) weeks prior to game date. Must register your Pogo Pass by clicking the link that will appear on this page to reserve your tickets at will call. Tickets are emailed to all reserved pass holders the day before the game. Registration closes 24 hrs prior to game time.
Your pass will get you into Makutu’s Island in Chandler twice with your year-long pass (Monday-Friday). Tickets are usually $10 each.
IDEA museum (used to be Arizona Museum for Youth): Each pass holder can attend i.d.e.a Museum Two (2) times during normal business hours (closed on Monday). Children 1 yrs of age and up are $8 admission if they do not have a valid Pogo Pass. Children are required to wear socks in play area. ** Excludes opening weekend (Fri, Sat, Sun) of opening exhibitions, 3 weekends a year. Simply present your Pogo Pass at admissions desk for entrance. Since admission is usually $8, this adds $16 of value to your POGO pass.
Enchanted Island: Your Pogo Pass is good for a Day Pass four (4) times at Enchanted Island Park Friday and Sundays during regular business hours. Not valid during Enchanted Island special events (I would call ahead before you go). Limited capacity, first come first serve. Some rides may require additional charge. A day pass is usually $17 for anyone under 54 inches, $10 for anyone over.
Sun Devil Athletics: Pogo Pass is a accepted for general admission tickets to ALL of the following ASU athletic home games: Women’s Basketball, Soccer, Wrestling, Volleyball, Gymnastics, Track and Field. **No need to pre-register for tickets to attend. Simply present your Pogo pass at will call or the front gate to gain admissions.
National Comedy Theater: Each pass holder can attend 2 shows. MUST call for a reservation. Seating is limited. First come first serve. Note: Please honor your reservations. Reservations will be cancelled for those who are not in their seats 5 minutes prior to show. Tickets are usually $14 each.
Skateland: Each pass holder can attend Skateland two (2) times per month. Skateland has three (3) different locations available to pass holders. Simply present your Pogo Pass card at the front counter to gain admission to Skateland. Skate Rental not included. There are 3 locations (one in Mesa, one in Glendale, and one in Chandler).
Phoenix Rock Gym: Pogo Pass holders can attend Phoenix Rock Gym two (2) times. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Rock Gym. Waiver required for 18 and younger. Limited capacity, first come first serve. *Climbing gear available upon request for $5.
Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is valid for 12 months. NOTE: Pogo Passes may be used on Mondays and Wednesdays 4:30-close. Pogo Passes may not be used during school holiday breaks or Stratum’s designated holiday hours. No exceptions.
Tempe Paintball: Pogo Pass holders can attend Tempe Paintball one (1) time per month for 12 months that include gun rental, air, and 100 paintballs. Check for seasonal hours and scheduled groups or events before scheduling your visit. Keep in mind that all participants must be 10 years or older, and must sign a waiver before prior to entering the arena. Note: This is not good on Saturdays.
Arizona Rattlers: (1) One ticket per game per pass holder for three (3) Arizona Rattlers home games at the US Airways Center for the AFL regular season.
Available Games for the 2015 season:
Sat, July 11 vs. Las Vegas Outlaws 6:00 PM
Sat, August 8 vs. Portland Thunder 6:00 PM

posts.title: Near Fountain Hills? FREE Papa Murphy's Pepperoni Pizza to the First 100 in Line for Grand Opening! Deals All Day Saturday, January 17th!
posts.excerpt: If you love Papa Murphy's, you may want to stop by their newest location in Fountain Hills Saturday morning (January 17th)! Starting at 10 AM the first 100…
posts.text:
If you love Papa Murphy's, you may want to stop by their newest location in Fountain Hills Saturday morning (January 17th)! Starting at 10 AM the first 100 people in line will receive a free pepperoni pizza! For the rest of the day, pepperoni pizzas will be on sale for just $4!
Even if you're not near Fountain Hills, participating Papa Murphy's around the valley will offering 20% off all day (I would call ahead to make sure that your location in honoring the deal).
"Papa Murphy’s, the country’s largest take ‘n’ bake pizza chain, has opened a brand new store in Fountain Hills at 13525 North Fountain Hills Blvd. The Fountain Hills store is open Sunday-Thursday from 10:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m., Friday and Saturday from 10:00 a.m. – 9:00 p.m. Owned by David and Spencer Perry, the newest Arizona Papa Murphy’s has received a warm welcome from the local community.
“As soon as we found our location in Fountain Hills we knew it would be perfect fit for a Papa Murphy’s--call it a gut feeling. We are delighted with the response and welcome we’ve received from our neighbors and we look forward to serving them for years to come,” said David Perry.
On Saturday, Jan. 17, the first 100 customers in line at the new location will receive a free large signature pepperoni pizza. This promotion starts at 10:00 a.m. and will last until 100 people have received their free pie. For the rest of the day on Jan. 17, large signature pepperoni pizzas will cost $4 each.
Additionally the new location will offer customers pizza tasting, games, prizes and other kid-friendly activities throughout the day on Jan. 17.
Customers can text AZ095 to 90421 for a chance to win pizza for a year as part of the grand opening festivities.* A winner will be drawn on Monday, Jan. 19 and the winner will be notified by the store.
The Perrys and their team are committed to creating excellent pizzas for every guest. Papa Murphy’s dough is scratch-made with love daily using high protein wheat flour. Each pizzais handmade to order and features fresh-grated 100 percent whole-milk mozzarella, cheddar, and provolone cheeses. We use butcher-quality meat toppings, with no fillers, which include crispy bacon, Canadian bacon, salami, pepperoni, Italian sausage, ground beef and grilled chicken. Other sliced-by-hand toppings include Roma tomatoes, mushrooms, onions, green peppers, and zucchini. Pizza lovers can also add unique toppings like spinach, sun-dried tomatoes, and artichokes.
With over 1,400 locations, Papa Murphy's is widely acknowledged for bringing families together through fresh, high-quality, convenient food they love.
The Fountain Hills location can be reached at 480-837-4669."
Thanks Charlotte!
Enjoy!

Head over here to get HALF OFF tickets to Youth American Ballet Company's Nutcracker! The shows will be Friday, December 19th through Sunday, December 21st at Desert Ridge high school in Mesa (note not in Desert Ridge!). You can see a beautiful video about the production here too.
"$12 for house right seating (up to $25 value)
$12 for house left seating (up to $25 value)
$15 for center house seating (up to $30 value)
Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. Sneaking downstairs to see the toy after everyone else has gone to bed, she suddenly finds herself caught in the middle of a pitched battle between the toys and an army of mice. After saving the nutcracker with a well-thrown shoe to the Mouse King's head, Clara and her now-living prince venture into the Land of Snow and the Land of Sweets to celebrate.
Throughout their adventures, Tchaikovsky's dazzling inventiveness propels the dances of nimble flowers and regal fairy queens. The "Waltz of the Snowflakes" floats weightlessly above the angelic voices of a youth choir, whereas the "Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy" tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. A medley of exotic national dances—including a Spanish bolero and Russian Trepak—add to the phantasmagoric celebration before the whole dream ends, as all dreams must."
It's always a wonderful time to take the family to see the Nutcracker during the holiday season! These seats are a bargain!
Enjoy!

"Challenger Space Center and Museum is on a mission: to excite and educate its visitors about science and the vast wonders of outer space. That excitement starts as soon as guests walk onto the entrance's elevated gantry bridge to see a four-story, space-themed mural painted by Robert McCall. Then it's on to the museum, where the center's affiliation with the Smithsonian Institution enables it to offer top-notch exhibits, which range from a model of an Iridium satellite to three separate meteorite exhibits. Beneath theplanetarium’s night sky, stargazers can learn about the stars or test their wishes out on different constellations. Regular Family Star Nights encourage families to bond over stargazing presentations, a simulated shuttle launch, and other activities.
To immerse themselves in the space experience, groups can also sign up for two-hour simulated space missions that unfold in three spaces: a mission control room designed after the Johnson Space Center; the Spacecraft, which simulates a room onboard the International Space Station; and the Earth Space Transit Module, which helps crew members dock there."
Have fun!

posts.text:
This is SUPER HOT! Head over here for more information about an AMAZING promotion at Scottsdale Quarter! You can get a FREE night at the Westin Kierland (worth $149) when you spend $450 at two or more shops and/or restaurants at Scottsdale Quarter. They have all kinds of stores like Sephora, Lululemon, H&M, and tons of others. The promotion goes from June 2nd-June 15th.
Here's what I did (I called to confirm that were eligible as part of the promotion and got the deal this afternoon):
I went to C3 and bought an iced tea for $2 (they have really delicious tea).
Then I went to the Scottsdale Quarter management office with my tea receipt and bought a $450 Visa gift card. There was a $2 fee but I figured since I used my credit card, I'm getting more than that in cash back. I'll use the gift card everywhere they accept Visa until it's gone (I hate carrying cash and always use my card and pay it off at the end of the month, so it won't change how I do things except for using another card until it's gone). The tea and the gift card counted as buying things in two separate shops or restaurants, so I got the voucher for the FREE night at the Westin Kierland.
The Scottsdale Quarter management office is open Monday-Friday from 9-5 and is located next to Urban Outfitters.
Here are the terms and conditions of the free night:
Advance reservations are required. Offer does not include resort service charge (I called and found out the resort fee is $28.07). You don't have to pay the room tax!
Offer is valid for one-night stay from June 2nd, 2014-August 29th, 2014. Offer is based on availability.
Black out dates: 6/14, 6/21, 6/28, 7/5, 7/12, and 8/2
Voucher must be received and stay booked and redeemed by same individual. Identification will be required at check-in.
Voucher has no cash value
Guests must cancel 48 hours prior to stay
Not valid with other offers or promotions.
Enjoy!
